title: Madeira in November: Weather, Sea Temperature and What to Do
description: Madeira in November: about 21°C days, fewer crowds and sea still warm enough for a boat day. What to pack, what to do, and how to plan your trip in Funchal.
heroAlt: A rainbow over the Madeira coast and a boat on the sea in November
keywords: what to do in Madeira in November
